'''2020 TMW Pods Steve Baroni DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
